verification._note: Kept in exact agreement with the runtime manifest so this contract resolves directly into a valid readiness manifest. Two runtime constraints are encoded here deliberately. (1) The gate's subprocess inherits NOTHING from an interactive shell, so DATABASE_URL and DATABASE_URL_TEST are inline -- a prior lane lost rounds to a bare `pnpm test` (autopilot-backlog.md). (2) No entry may contain a `<` or `>` character: autopilot-review-readiness.mjs:225 treats ANY angle bracket as an unresolved placeholder and halts CONTRACT_INVALID, which rejects an ordinary `2>&1` redirect. That is why the silence proof is a vitest assertion inside the suite rather than a shell pipeline here -- which is the better home for it anyway, since it then guards against regression on every future run. NOT using `pnpm test`: it is red on base 405cc58 for reasons outside this diff (scripts/autopilot-ephemeral-review-worktree.test.mjs, 4 bracket-path cases), and because it chains with &&, a bare `pnpm test` never even reaches the package suites.
